_about: Plain-language release notes, keyed by commit hash (as in changelog.json). scripts/build-changelog.mjs applies them: "text" replaces the commit subject people see (the subject stays in commit_text); "audience": "developer" marks a line the portal What's new page leaves out. Write for the people using the app: what they will notice, no table, field, route or code names.

626b47ea7.text: Worklist filters no longer fill in your default zone or year by themselves. They open empty, and you still only see what you have access to.

a2c5809d2.text: The person who raised a request is no longer listed as an approver on steps that already have approvers.

40b444ea4.text: Reports and dashboard figures that cannot be limited to the zones you have access to no longer run, instead of showing data from other zones.

559649cdd.text: Record forms keep your reason and unsaved changes more reliably, search finds codes like 2026-NNO-POWER by their parts, and dashboard zone counts now match the worklists.

989393a02.text: Notifications name a record only if you can still open it.

ca417a2cf.text: Fast typing in forms no longer drops characters, record headers show the record name instead of an internal number, and history shows line changes as sentences.

29226e9d7.text: Filters on linked records can no longer reveal values you are not allowed to see.

d35797f48.text: Saving a record no longer overwrites a colleague's change made while you had it open, and new units can be created again.

788acdf5e.text: Pickers that depend on another choice, such as project type, project, location and unit type, show their options again.

4b0c64bdf.text: A record save that is only partly accepted now says so and keeps your draft, and budget totals round correctly.

37b76fbe7.text: Resolving a conflicting edit saves only the values you chose to keep.

ab8a0d190.text: Typing amounts like 2.05 no longer turns them into 25, and new inventory requests notify their first approvers.

1f3e17a34.text: What's new now describes each release in plain language.

e562f0fc1.text: Worklists show records by their usual numbers and names, and the count tiles never run ahead of the rows below them.

cbb8d206f.text: Administrators are told about new access requests in the right place, and error messages give the same help on every page.

cd1300e6b.text: Approver lists stay correct on very large pipelines, and people removed from a step stop being listed.

f8783cc26.text: Searching for an exact record number always finds the record, even when the rest of the search is slow.

191669e3e.text: Sorting a list by a related record's field works, and only sorts what you are allowed to see.

af7f17a75.text: The next page of a list loads faster, and the row menu names records by their usual numbers.

4485db113.text: After the last approval a record is locked to administrators, but a few things such as putting it on hold stay open, and a Request help button asks for any other change.

a81a5dc45.text: Some fields can now be set so that only administrators change them; everyone else sees them read-only.

992ef8b96.text: Information a step asks for when you move a record is saved even when the record is locked after approval.

77607a3d2.text: Some moves on approved records are now reserved for administrators.

90cdea72f.text: Copying a Shipped cell now includes the latest shipping events.

ab2db0f1c.text: Summary views can have their own phone and tablet versions.

2aa7a879b.text: Toolbars, tabs and record headers hold up better on narrow screens.

9ea61e7b1.text: On a record that is only partly locked, the locked fields can no longer be typed into.
